# Validation
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'), (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'), (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call')]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a NumPy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} cannot be empty")
        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain only finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be nonpositive")
    # Check shape consistency
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    # Validate threshold
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool) or not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative numeric value")

    # Compute per-candidate loss (negative sum of log probabilities)
    loss_with = -np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1)
    loss_call = -np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1)
    loss_no_call = -np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # Compute margin: for each candidate, take the minimum of (loss_alternative + tau) - loss_with
    # That ensures both conditions: loss_with < loss_call + tau and loss_with < loss_no_call + tau
    margin_call = (loss_call + tau_filter) - loss_with
    margin_no_call = (loss_no_call + tau_filter) - loss_with
    margins = np.minimum(margin_call, margin_no_call)

    # Keep if margin is strictly positive
    keep = margins > 0.0

    return keep, margins
